data.title: 1. Load Temperature Data
data.description: Load CSV file containing temperature sensor readings with timestamps from monitoring stations

executable.code:
import json
import random

print("="*60)
print("🌡️  STEP 1: LOADING TEMPERATURE DATA")
print("="*60)
print("")
print("💝 Pickup Line: Are you a temperature sensor? Because you're giving me some HOT readings! 🔥")
print("")

# Generate sample temperature data
print("📊 Generating sample temperature readings...")
data = {
    "readings": [round(random.uniform(15.0, 35.0), 2) for _ in range(10)],
    "timestamps": [f"2024-01-01T{h:02d}:00:00Z" for h in range(10)],
    "source": "temperature_sensor_001"
}

print(f"✅ Successfully generated {len(data['readings'])} temperature readings")
print(f"📍 Source: {data['source']}")
print(f"🔢 Sample values: {data['readings'][:3]}...")
print(f"📏 Min: {min(data['readings'])}°C, Max: {max(data['readings'])}°C")

# Write to shared volume
with open("/shared/node_n1_output.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)

print("💾 Data saved to /shared/node_n1_output.json")
print("✨ Step 1 complete!\n")

data.title: 2. Clean & Validate Data
data.description: Remove invalid readings (null values, outliers) and filter temperatures outside valid range (-50°C to 50°C)

executable.code:
import json

print("="*60)
print("🧹 STEP 2: CLEANING & VALIDATING DATA")
print("="*60)
print("")
print("💝 Pickup Line: Are you data validation? Because you make my heart skip a NaN! 💓")
print("")

# Read input from previous node
print("📖 Reading data from previous step...")
with open("/shared/node_n1_output.json", "r") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

print(f"📥 Loaded {len(data['readings'])} readings from {data['source']}")

# Clean and validate (filter valid range)
print("🔍 Validating temperature range (-50°C to 50°C)...")
initial_count = len(data["readings"])
valid_readings = [r for r in data["readings"] if -50 <= r <= 50]
invalid_count = initial_count - len(valid_readings)

if invalid_count > 0:
    print(f"⚠️  Filtered out {invalid_count} invalid reading(s)")
else:
    print("✅ All readings are within valid range!")

data["readings"] = valid_readings
data["cleaned"] = True
data["valid_count"] = len(valid_readings)

print(f"📊 Valid readings: {len(valid_readings)}")
print(f"✔️  Range check: All values between {min(valid_readings):.2f}°C and {max(valid_readings):.2f}°C")

# Write cleaned data
with open("/shared/node_n2_output.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)

print("💾 Cleaned data saved to /shared/node_n2_output.json")
print("✨ Step 2 complete!\n")
